test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The Young Global Leaders Community is an ________ for a dynamic community of exceptional people with the vision, courage, and influence to drive positive change in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is **"accelerator **" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's have a look at the correct sentence:

__
 
• The Young Global Leaders Community is an ***accelerator__*** for a dynamic community of exceptional people with the vision, courage, and influence to drive positive change in the world.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Here we will see the meaning of the given word with another example:

 
• **Accelerator - **one that accelerates: such as: a muscle or nerve that speeds the performance of an action; a device (such as a gas pedal) for increasing the speed of a motor vehicle engine; a substance that speeds a chemical reaction.

 
 
• ***Eg***. Boot the *accelerator*, and the little four-cylinder engine strains to reach its 6000-rpm redline.
